meaning.en: Having nothing left to say, whether from being proved wrong, from disappointment or from complete agreement.
meaning.zh: 没有什么话可以说，或理屈词穷，或失望，或完全赞同。

examples.zh: 面对确凿的证据，他无话可说。
examples.en: Faced with solid evidence, he had nothing to say.

examples.zh: 对于这样的结果，我真是无话可说。
examples.en: I'm simply lost for words at a result like this.

usage.en: Usually a predicate; may express guilt, disappointment or, less often, no objection.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可表示理亏、失望，也可表示没有异议。

meaning.en: Staying calm and collected when something happens.
meaning.zh: 遇到事情时保持镇静，不慌乱。

equivalents: keep a cool head in a crisis

examples.zh: 消防员遇事镇定，很快疏散了人群。
examples.en: The firefighter kept a cool head and soon evacuated the crowd.

examples.zh: 好的领导者必须遇事镇定。
examples.en: A good leader has to stay calm when things happen.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praises a person's temperament.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，称赞人的性格。

meaning.en: Having vivid, strongly contrasting colours; also, of a style or stance, having a clear distinctive character.
meaning.zh: 颜色鲜艳分明；也指风格、立场等特点突出。

examples.zh: 这幅油画色彩鲜明，很吸引眼球。
examples.en: This oil painting is vividly coloured and catches the eye.

examples.zh: 她的立场色彩鲜明，从不含糊。
examples.en: Her position is clear-cut; she is never vague.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for paintings, clothes and also for clear political or stylistic leanings.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，可形容画作、服饰，也可形容立场、风格。

meaning.en: To lay a trap or scheme in order to lure someone into trouble.
meaning.zh: 布置陷阱或阴谋，引人上当。

examples.zh: 骗子设下圈套，让不少老人上当。
examples.en: The fraudsters set a trap and many elderly people were taken in.

examples.zh: 他们设下圈套，想引对手犯错。
examples.en: They set a trap to lure their rival into a mistake.

usage.en: Verb-object; often with 给…／让…. Fits both real scams and schemes.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常带“给／让”，既指骗局也指计谋。

meaning.en: To perform distinguished service and win lasting honour, especially for the country.
meaning.zh: 立下卓著的功劳，多指为国家。

examples.zh: 他在战争年代为国家建立功勋。
examples.en: In the war years he rendered distinguished service to the country.

examples.zh: 许多科学家在艰苦环境中建立功勋。
examples.en: Many scientists achieved great things in harsh conditions.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal and weighty, used for military, political or scientific feats.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，语体较庄重，多用于军事、政治、科研成就。

meaning.en: To be toughened by going through hard training and difficulties.
meaning.zh: 在艰苦的训练和困难中得到锻炼。

examples.zh: 年轻人需要在基层经受磨炼。
examples.en: Young people need to be tempered at the grassroots.

examples.zh: 经受磨炼之后，他变得更成熟了。
examples.en: After going through the mill, he became more mature.

usage.en: Verb-object; often with 在…中. Positive, about growth through adversity.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常用“在……中”，指在逆境中成长。

meaning.en: Living a debauched, self-indulgent life with no restraint.
meaning.zh: 生活荒唐淫乱，毫无节制。

examples.zh: 这位君主荒淫放纵，终致亡国。
examples.en: The ruler was dissolute and unrestrained, and in the end lost his kingdom.

examples.zh: 他荒淫放纵，把家产挥霍一空。
examples.en: He lived licentiously and squandered the family fortune.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strongly critical, formal or bookish.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，贬义强烈，偏书面。

meaning.en: Secretly malicious and dangerous; of a person or scheme, vicious and treacherous.
meaning.zh: 暗中狠毒，危险恶劣，形容人心或计谋。

examples.zh: 他用心阴毒险恶，没人敢信任他。
examples.en: His intentions were so sinister that nobody dared trust him.

examples.zh: 这场阴谋阴毒险恶，令人不寒而栗。
examples.en: The plot was vicious and treacherous, enough to chill the blood.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; describes people, motives or schemes.
usage.zh: 作定语或谓语，形容人、用心、计谋。

meaning.en: To collapse completely, whether a system, a defence or a person's emotions.
meaning.zh: 完全垮掉，可指制度、防线，也指人的精神。

examples.zh: 防线彻底崩溃，敌军溃不成军。
examples.en: The defence collapsed completely and the enemy fell into disarray.

examples.zh: 听到噩耗，她彻底崩溃了。
examples.en: On hearing the terrible news, she completely broke down.

usage.en: Predicate; 彻底 is an adverb, so it is placed before 崩溃.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，“彻底”作状语。

meaning.en: Being bold enough to try new things without fear of failure.
meaning.zh: 敢于尝试新事物，不怕失败。

examples.zh: 年轻人应该勇于尝试，不怕犯错。
examples.en: Young people should dare to try and not fear mistakes.

examples.zh: 这家公司鼓励员工勇于尝试新方法。
examples.en: The company encourages staff to try out new methods.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; used in advice and praise.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常见于勉励和表扬。

meaning.en: Refusing to stop or let a matter drop, often stubbornly.
meaning.zh: 不愿意停止，不肯了结，常带固执意味。

examples.zh: 他没拿到赔偿就是不肯罢休。
examples.en: He refused to let it drop until he had his compensation.

examples.zh: 对方纠缠不清，不肯罢休。
examples.en: The other side kept at it and wouldn't give up.

usage.en: Predicate; usually negative or neutral; 不肯 shows stubbornness.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多含贬义或中性，“不肯”表示固执。

meaning.en: Prosperity and decline are unpredictable and never last.
meaning.zh: 兴盛和衰落没有定数，难以长久。

examples.zh: 历史上王朝兴衰无常，没有永远的强者。
examples.en: Dynasties have risen and fallen unpredictably; no power is for ever.

examples.zh: 商场兴衰无常，企业要有危机感。
examples.en: Fortunes in business are fickle, so firms need a sense of crisis.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; reflective, often in remarks on history or business.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常用于感慨历史或商界。

meaning.en: Flowers of every kind blooming splendidly at once.
meaning.zh: 各种花朵同时盛开。

examples.zh: 春天来了，公园里百花盛开。
examples.en: Spring has come and the park is full of blossom.

examples.zh: 百花盛开的季节，游客络绎不绝。
examples.en: In the season when flowers bloom everywhere, visitors come in a stream.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also figuratively for a flourishing scene (百花齐放).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，也可比喻繁荣局面。

meaning.en: To contribute selflessly, without seeking recognition or reward.
meaning.zh: 默默无闻地付出，不求回报。

examples.zh: 许多老师在山区默默奉献了一辈子。
examples.en: Many teachers have quietly given their whole lives in the mountains.

examples.zh: 社区志愿者默默奉献，赢得了居民的尊敬。
examples.en: The community volunteers earned residents' respect by giving quietly.

usage.en: Predicate; widely used in praise, news and speeches.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于表扬、新闻和演讲。

meaning.en: To have learned something so well that it is firmly in the memory.
meaning.zh: 牢牢记在心里，非常熟悉。

examples.zh: 考试前，他把公式都熟记于心。
examples.en: Before the exam he learned all the formulae by heart.

examples.zh: 这些规章制度要熟记于心。
examples.en: These regulations must be committed to memory.

usage.en: Verb phrase, usually with 把 or as a verb; stresses thorough memorising.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用“把”字句，强调记得牢固。

meaning.en: Worn out by the toil of a long journey.
meaning.zh: 旅行路上劳累疲乏。

examples.zh: 旅途劳顿，他一进酒店就睡着了。
examples.en: Worn out by the journey, he fell asleep as soon as he reached the hotel.

examples.zh: 您一路旅途劳顿，先休息一下吧。
examples.en: You must be tired after the trip; please rest first.

usage.en: Predicate; polite, often in welcoming a guest (您旅途劳顿了).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，迎接客人时常用作客套话。

meaning.en: To pick out and promote able people for important roles.
meaning.zh: 挑选并提拔有才能的人。

examples.zh: 公司通过公开考试选拔人才。
examples.en: The company selects talent through open examinations.

examples.zh: 选拔人才要看实际能力，而不是关系。
examples.en: Selecting talent should depend on real ability, not connections.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal, common in news, HR and policy writing.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，语体较正式，多见于新闻、人事和政策文件。

meaning.en: To get out of a difficult or desperate situation.
meaning.zh: 从艰难的处境中解脱出来。

examples.zh: 这家企业终于摆脱困境，开始盈利了。
examples.en: The firm finally got out of trouble and began to make a profit.

examples.zh: 他努力工作，想尽快摆脱困境。
examples.en: He works hard to get out of difficulty as soon as possible.

usage.en: Verb-object; common in news and everyday talk.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，新闻和日常均常用。

meaning.en: To turn something down in a tactful, indirect way.
meaning.zh: 用含蓄、不伤人的方式拒绝。

examples.zh: 她委婉拒绝了对方的邀请。
examples.en: She tactfully declined the invitation.

examples.zh: 面对不合理的要求，他只好委婉拒绝。
examples.en: Faced with an unreasonable request, he had to decline gently.

usage.en: Verb phrase; 委婉 is adverbial. Suggests courtesy, not bluntness.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，“委婉”作状语，表示客气而不生硬。

meaning.en: To hope for something earnestly and eagerly.
meaning.zh: 恳切而热烈地盼望。

examples.zh: 父母殷切期待着孩子的好消息。
examples.en: The parents eagerly awaited good news from their child.

examples.zh: 全国人民殷切期待这项政策落实。
examples.en: People nationwide are eagerly waiting for this policy to be put into effect.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; formal and warm, common in speeches and news.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，语体正式而深情，常见于讲话和新闻。

meaning.en: A rich harvest of grain.
meaning.zh: 粮食获得好收成。

examples.zh: 今年风调雨顺，粮食丰收。
examples.en: With good weather this year, the grain harvest was bumper.

examples.zh: 粮食丰收，农民脸上露出了笑容。
examples.en: With a rich grain harvest, smiles appeared on the farmers' faces.

usage.en: Predicate; common in news about agriculture. 粮食 is pronounced liáng shi.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于农业新闻。

meaning.en: To have wicked or unlawful designs in mind.
meaning.zh: 心里怀着不正当的企图。

examples.zh: 那个陌生人心怀不轨，大家要小心。
examples.en: That stranger is up to no good, so everyone should be careful.

examples.zh: 他对我们这么热情，我怀疑他心怀不轨。
examples.en: He is so friendly to us that I suspect he has ulterior motives.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; strongly critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，贬义较强。

meaning.en: Human life is uncertain and subject to sudden change.
meaning.zh: 人的一生变化不定，难以预料。

examples.zh: 经历这场变故，他感叹人生无常。
examples.en: After the upheaval he sighed that life is unpredictable.

examples.zh: 人生无常，要珍惜眼前的幸福。
examples.en: Life is uncertain, so treasure the happiness before you.

usage.en: Usually a sentence in itself or a clause; reflective, with a Buddhist flavour.
usage.zh: 常独立成句或作分句，带有感慨，有佛家色彩。

meaning.en: Having an ordinary appearance, neither handsome nor ugly.
meaning.zh: 长相普通，不出众。

examples.zh: 他相貌平平，但是待人真诚。
examples.en: He is plain-looking but sincere with everyone.

examples.zh: 这位相貌平平的老人，竟是著名科学家。
examples.en: This ordinary-looking old man turns out to be a famous scientist.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; slightly modest, not insulting.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，语气较委婉，不算冒犯。

meaning.en: A mind free of distracting thoughts; fully focused.
meaning.zh: 心里没有杂乱的念头，专心一意。

examples.zh: 打坐时他心无杂念，进入了宁静的状态。
examples.en: In meditation he cleared his mind and entered a state of calm.

examples.zh: 比赛时要心无杂念，全力以赴。
examples.en: In the match you must keep your mind clear and give your all.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; describes focus, meditation or study.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，形容专注、静心。

meaning.en: To help parties in a dispute to settle it peacefully.
meaning.zh: 居间劝解，使争执双方和解。

examples.zh: 居委会负责调解纠纷，邻里关系更融洽了。
examples.en: The neighbourhood committee mediates disputes, and neighbours now get along better.

examples.zh: 他擅长调解纠纷，大家都信服他。
examples.en: He is good at settling disputes and everyone trusts him.

usage.en: Verb-object; common in legal, community and news contexts.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，常见于法律、社区和新闻语境。

meaning.en: To make a show of one's military strength in order to intimidate.
meaning.zh: 夸耀自己的军事实力，借以威吓别人。

examples.zh: 该国在边境炫耀武力，引起邻国不安。
examples.en: The country flexed its military muscle on the border, unsettling its neighbours.

examples.zh: 炫耀武力解决不了问题。
examples.en: Showing off force won't solve the problem.

usage.en: Verb-object; common in news commentary, negative.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，多见于新闻评论，贬义。

meaning.en: Having depraved moral character and behaviour.
meaning.zh: 道德品质和行为很坏。

examples.zh: 这个人品行败坏，不配当老师。
examples.en: This man is morally corrupt and unfit to be a teacher.

examples.zh: 他因品行败坏被开除出队。
examples.en: He was expelled from the team for corrupt conduct.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; a harsh moral judgement.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，道德评价很严厉。

meaning.en: So striking, shocking or disagreeable that people look at it askance.
meaning.zh: 因出格、惊人或令人不满而使人斜眼注视。

examples.zh: 他的奢华排场令人侧目。
examples.en: His lavish display made people raise their eyebrows.

examples.zh: 这家公司的增长速度令人侧目。
examples.en: The company's growth rate turns heads.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; the nuance is surprise or disapproval, not pure praise.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，含惊诧或不满，并非单纯褒义。

literal: strict · in order to · treat · others

meaning.en: To hold others to strict standards; often criticised when one is lenient with oneself.
meaning.zh: 用严格的标准要求别人。

equivalents: hold others to a high standard

examples.zh: 他严以待人，宽以待己，同事们都有意见。
examples.en: He is strict with others and lenient with himself, and colleagues object.

examples.zh: 好领导应严以待人，更要严以律己。
examples.en: A good leader is strict with others and, above all, with himself.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 宽以待己 (negative) or 严以律己 (positive).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“宽以待己”（贬）或“严以律己”（褒）对举。

meaning.en: Full of energy and vitality, like the morning.
meaning.zh: 充满活力，像早晨一样有生气。

examples.zh: 校园里的年轻人个个充满朝气。
examples.en: Young people on campus are all full of vitality.

examples.zh: 这是一支充满朝气的新队伍。
examples.en: This is a new team full of energy.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 朝 is read zhāo here, meaning morning.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语；“朝”读 zhāo，指早晨。

meaning.en: To win victory after victory, advancing step by step.
meaning.zh: 一步步取得胜利，连连获胜。

examples.zh: 我军节节胜利，士气高昂。
examples.en: Our army won victory after victory and morale was high.

examples.zh: 球队一路节节胜利，打进决赛。
examples.en: The team kept on winning and reached the final.

usage.en: Predicate, often with 取得 or as adverbial; used for war, sport and business.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，用于战争、体育、商业。

meaning.en: To see again after blindness; also, to emerge from darkness or oppression into hope.
meaning.zh: 盲人重新看见；也比喻摆脱黑暗，获得新生。

examples.zh: 手术后，老人终于重获光明。
examples.en: After the operation the old man finally regained his sight.

examples.zh: 国家解放后，人民重获光明。
examples.en: After liberation the people saw the light again.

usage.en: Verb-object; 重 is read chóng (again). Literal or figurative.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，“重”读 chóng；可用本义，也可比喻。

natural: see the big in the small

meaning.en: To glimpse a larger truth through a small detail.
meaning.zh: 从小事情中看出大道理。

equivalents: see the big picture in a small detail
a small thing reveals a lot

examples.zh: 这篇文章小中见大，写出了时代的变迁。
examples.en: The essay sees the large in the small and captures the changing times.

examples.zh: 好的新闻报道往往小中见大。
examples.en: Good reporting often reveals the big story through a small one.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; common in comments on writing, design and observation.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，常用于评论文章、设计、观察。

natural: line the road to see off

meaning.en: To line both sides of the road and cheerfully see someone off.
meaning.zh: 人们站在道路两旁热情欢送。

equivalents: line the streets to see someone off
give a send-off along the route

examples.zh: 乡亲们夹道欢送子弟兵。
examples.en: The villagers lined the road to bid the soldiers farewell.

examples.zh: 队员们出征时，球迷夹道欢送。
examples.en: As the players set off, fans lined the street to see them off.

usage.en: Predicate; formal and warm. The welcoming version is 夹道欢迎.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，语体庄重热烈；迎接则说“夹道欢迎”。

meaning.en: Two things relying on each other for survival or success.
meaning.zh: 彼此依靠，共同生存发展。

examples.zh: 人与自然相互依存，不能对立。
examples.en: Humans and nature depend on each other and must not be set against each other.

examples.zh: 两国经济相互依存。
examples.en: The two economies are interdependent.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; common in news and academic writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常见于新闻和学术文章。

meaning.en: To be at ease with a modest life and satisfied with what one has.
meaning.zh: 安于清贫，对所拥有的感到满足。

examples.zh: 他一生安贫知足，过得平静。
examples.en: All his life he was content with little and lived peacefully.

examples.zh: 安贫知足并不等于不求上进。
examples.en: Being content with a modest life does not mean lacking ambition.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; positive or mildly ironic when it excuses lack of drive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，褒义，有时略带讽刺。

meaning.en: To stay morally spotless; not be tainted by corruption or scandal.
meaning.zh: 保持品行纯洁，不沾污点。

examples.zh: 官员要保持清白，不能收受贿赂。
examples.en: Officials must keep their hands clean and never take bribes.

examples.zh: 他一辈子保持清白，赢得了尊重。
examples.en: He kept his name clean all his life and earned respect.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal; can refer to character, reputation or innocence.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，语体较正式，可指品行、名声或清白。

meaning.en: Hard to handle or beat, as a person or problem.
meaning.zh: 不容易应付或战胜。

examples.zh: 这个客户难以对付，每次都挑毛病。
examples.en: This client is hard to deal with and finds fault every time.

examples.zh: 对手实力强，的确难以对付。
examples.en: The opponent is strong and really hard to handle.

usage.en: Predicate; 难以 is a bookish 'hard to', followed by a verb.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，“难以”是书面语，后接动词。

meaning.en: To keep firm moral principles and national or personal integrity, especially under pressure.
meaning.zh: 在压力或诱惑面前坚守气节。

examples.zh: 他在狱中保持气节，从不屈服。
examples.en: In prison he held on to his integrity and never gave in.

examples.zh: 文人应保持气节，不趋炎附势。
examples.en: Scholars should keep their integrity and not curry favour with the powerful.

usage.en: Verb-object; formal, used of people under pressure.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，语体庄重，用于面临压力的人。

literal: remote · out of the way · desolate · bleak

meaning.en: Out of the way, thinly populated and bleak.
meaning.zh: 地方偏远，人烟稀少，景象冷清。

examples.zh: 这个小村庄偏僻荒凉，几乎没人去。
examples.en: The little village is remote and desolate and hardly anyone goes there.

examples.zh: 他被派往偏僻荒凉的边疆工作。
examples.en: He was posted to work in the remote and desolate frontier.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; describes places, usually negatively.
usage.zh: 作定语或谓语，形容地方，多含消极意味。
